scope: Own named-slot archive Unix IPC/CLI, bounded file-backed transfer, cancellation, durable import acknowledgement and restart/readback without device application

contract.rpc: profile_archive request actions begin_export/begin_import/chunk/read/inspect/finish/status/cancel/release; caller-generated32 lowercase hex ID; exact Begin/Chunk retries; target group/slot and revision fixed at Begin
contract.limits: 4 sessions,2 blocking admission permits,64KiB transfer blocks, retained-transfer reserve<=2*MAX_PROFILE_ARCHIVE_BYTES; anonymous files,300s idle TTL and15s weak-owner sweeper; deterministic expiry/quota logic tested, no300s wall-clock observation
contract.ownership: Blocking permit/file ownership outlives abandoned RPC futures. Busy transaction returns DeviceBusy; HID/device actors do not own archive work. Packing and atomic Finish are not interactively interruptible.
contract.durable_receipt: Last64 ArchiveImportReceipt records live in profiles.json, atomically with slot commit. Recovery re-syncs visible ambiguous commit before acknowledging. Identical Finish/Status after lost reply/restart does not republish assets.
contract.current_readback: Later library revision appears in status along with original committed_revision and profile:null, including cached sessions. Old operations never resurrect deleted/reset slots. Evicted receipts remain protected by stale original expected_revision.
contract.cli: profiles export GROUP SLOT FILE; profiles import GROUP SLOT FILE; archive-state/archive-finish/archive-cancel ID. Atomic no-overwrite output, local validation before IPC, progress/operation ID stderr and --json. Ctrl+C before Finish performs Cancel/Release; committed import is never undone.

coverage: Begin/Chunk exact retries, Finish idempotence and receipt recovery after memory Release

actual imported profile contains remapped valid assets; HID write count remains0
